construction.statement: The GUV'NOR cleanroom verifier (emilia-rust-verifier / ep-cleanroom-verifier, Rust) was implemented from EMILIA specifications and the published conformance vectors without consulting EMILIA Protocol reference source (packages/verify, packages/python-verify, packages/go-verify, or equivalent). One-team JS/Python/Go ports were not used as implementation guides. God Terminal and Continuum integration call this binary as an external process; that wiring does not change the verifier's clean-room status. Conformance v2 clean-room verification complete as of public ecr-wg commit 11bff6dee6ce56a082921c1c169c3e0707913711 (tree rust/ep-cleanroom-verifier @ c30ed51178f167c99d5214c5f8581172c1641af0).
